# Fullsend

> Autonomous SDLC agents for your codebase

Fullsend is a platform for fully autonomous agentic development for GitHub-hosted organizations. It provides triage, code generation, review, fix, retro, and prioritization agents that operate on GitHub issues and pull requests.

## Docs

Each docs page is also a markdown file. Fetch the source by adding a `.md` suffix to the page URL (`/docs/agents/triage` → `/docs/agents/triage.md`). Directory URLs (trailing slash) use `index.md` (`/docs/agents/` → `/docs/agents/index.md`).

The links below are the current stable docs (`https://fullsend.sh/docs/...`). Other builds live under `/docs/v/<version>/`: aliases `stable`, `edge`, and `dev`, plus tagged releases `vX.Y.Z`. The same `.md` suffix applies (`/docs/v/v0.39.0/agents/triage` → `/docs/v/v0.39.0/agents/triage.md`). The version list is at https://fullsend.sh/docs/v/.
